policy.name: DEFER_AND_CONTINUE
policy.description: When independent work is blocked by a genuine external, credential, physical-device, authorization, or platform boundary, record the blocker and resume condition, skip the blocked item, and continue other eligible work. Do not promote blocked work or substitute host evidence for external evidence.

items.resume_condition: A usable Vercel deployment credential or externally materialized project becomes available and the controller can be deployed and /api/health independently verified.
items.promotion_boundary: Merged deployment software is not evidence of a live deployment.

items.resume_condition: Device-origin commissioning evidence from a real authorized Android/Termux device is available for controller verification.
items.promotion_boundary: Host, CI, emulator, or queued-work evidence cannot satisfy the physical-device gate.

items.resume_condition: DEVICE_VALIDATED evidence exists and a real physical reboot can be observed with changed boot identity, worker return, fresh heartbeat, valid lease/event chain, and post-reboot bounded work verification.
items.promotion_boundary: Device validation does not imply persistence validation.

items.resume_condition: A real age provider and valid recipient are available; ciphertext is independently verified, replicated to an independently identified off-device target, retrieved, re-hashed, decrypted, and recovery-verified.
items.promotion_boundary: Fake-provider tests, local ciphertext, or host CI do not establish off-device disaster recovery.
